name: Ram
description:
Dog: Friendly male street dog, around 1.5 years old, medium build, with a brown coat and white patches. Very playful, affectionate, and gets along well with people and other pets. Recently vaccinated and dewormed. Ideal for a loving home with space to play and grow.
Cat: Sweet and calm female street cat, approximately 2 years old, with a soft grey and white coat. Loves cuddles and enjoys being around people. Independent yet affectionate. Vaccinated and litter-trained, making her an ideal companion for any pet-loving family.

name: Sri
description: Adorable female cat, approximately 6 months old, with a soft white and grey coat. Playful and curious, she loves exploring her surroundings and enjoys gentle cuddles. Very friendly and sociable, making her a perfect companion. Vaccinated and healthy, she’s ready to find a loving forever home. Suitable for both first-time and experienced pet parents.
